title: Independently qualify and close the local M6 scientific release gate
commitMessage: docs: qualify local M6 scientific release gate

contribution.summary: Independently qualify the local G-M6 scientific gate across 11 admitted phases, 22 tasks and 66 subtasks. Preserve two historical local NuGet SHA/byte receipts and 10 source-free consumers; run locked restore and fresh full Release solution tests. Complete M6 locally only, with stable/public publication and external adoption explicitly unapproved.
contribution.value: The BCL-only gate validates product/native completion, each phase's pinned evidence, the historical analysis and scientific archives, owner/semver/notices boundaries, and a fresh full solution test. Save SHA-bound validator, release decision and recipe; do not reissue packages or claim the 10 historical consumers were rerun.
debtChanges: M6 local scientific milestone completion must remain distinct from public/stable NuGet publication, license choice or external adoption.
RS105 full-solution tests do not rerun historical source-free NuGet consumers or recreate prior package bytes.
Retain preview.6 analysis and preview.14 scientific archive SHA/byte pins and explicit finite-domain numeric limits.
Decision reuse and migration stay owner-gated through semver/notices, recipient agreement and independent verification.
M7 precision, uncertainty, tensors and other advanced features require separately admitted or deferred contracts.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS105 success, verify G-M6, report counters and transitions. Pause for a product roadmap decision on M7 advanced-extension admission before preparing another run. Do not presume stable/public 1.1.0 publication, new licensing or external adoption.

achievements.achievement: Complete the M6 bounded local scientific milestone after independently checked 11-phase/22-task/66-subtask G-M6 evidence and fresh solution tests, with no publication or external adoption.
